info.title: ExtraHop
info.description: REST API for ExtraHop RevealX 360, the SaaS network detection and response (NDR) platform. Authentication: OAuth 2.0 client credentials.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 51 of 269 upstream operations covering devices, device groups, custom devices, detections, alerts, tags, and threat collections (watchlists). See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

servers.description: RevealX 360 API endpoint host, from the RevealX 360 API Access page. Replace CCP-HOST with the tenant-specific API host (Itential Platform Integration Models require a static server URL rather than OpenAPI server variables).
